name: Ishpan
overview: Ishpan was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Shashak. His mention in Scripture is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional personal notes or narrative details provided.
namesAndTitles: The name Ishpan likely means 'may God judge,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning rooted in the Hebrew language. This proper name is not indicated to have been given directly by God but carries a meaningful invocation of divine judgment.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Ishpan as the son of Shashak, establishing a clear paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ishpan's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as noted in 1 Chronicles 8:22. His mention contributes to the biblical record of the lineage and heritage of the Benjaminite tribe, which is important for understanding the historical and tribal context of Israel as preserved in Scripture.
